Title: Large storage for Azure Database for MariaDB

Body.Content: General availability support for up to 16TB of storage and up to 20,000 IOPS in Azure Database for MariaDB is now available. With this functionality, you not only have access to five times more storage for database servers, but also more than triple the available IOPS. This enables you to run the most demanding, large scale workloads on Azure Database for MariaDB. Learn more by reading the service documentation.
